summary: Downscales a 3D (volume) texture by 2x in each dimension using 8-sample trilinear float averaging (0.125). Validates an object type tag (byte at +8 must equal 5), verifies the destination dimensions (byte offsets 4184/4188/4192, also reachable as dword indices 1046/1047/1048) equal the source dimensions halved with a both-equal-1 exception, masks odd source dimensions even, allocates up to two 16-byte-element staging buffers, fetches 8 source floats per destination texel through a vtable slot-1 method, averages them, writes the result, frees both buffers and returns 0 on success or an HRESULT error code.

operations.description: SEHHandlerInit() installs the structured exception handler whose landing pad is loc_59C4BE.
Type-tag guard: the byte at object +8 must equal 5, otherwise return -2147467259.

Dimension validation: destination width (index 1046), height (index 1047) and depth (index 1048) must equal the corresponding source dimension halved, except when both sides equal 1; any violation returns -2147467259.
Even-alignment pass: when a source dimension at 4184/4188/4192 is greater than 1 and odd it is masked to even, and offset 4196 is reduced by offset 4200.
OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(16 * destination width) allocates the first staging buffer of 16-byte vector elements.
sub_5008C2 initialises the staged vector elements using the element constructor sub_5007EC.
If the first staging buffer is null, the function returns -2147024882.
A second staging buffer is allocated and element-constructed: 16-byte elements for 2x source width when source height (offset 4188) equals 1, otherwise 16-byte elements for 4x source width.
Nested do-while loops over the destination width (offset 4184), height (offset 4188) and depth (offset 4192) process every destination texel.
Source texels are fetched through the vtable method at slot +4 of the source object, addressing the four 16-byte staging planes for the trilinear taps.
Eight source floats are accumulated (two inner samples x four planes) for the trilinear tap.
Each of the four accumulated channels is scaled by 0.125 to average the 8 taps.
The four averaged floats are written to the destination buffer element.
FreeWrapper_7bcf releases both staging buffers before returning.
Returns 0 on success, -2147467259 on tag/dimension mismatch, and -2147024882 on allocation failure.
Invoked from D3DContextInit (005063a5) during Direct3D context initialisation.
